Applications for the Startup Nights 2026 Pitching Competition are now open! This year, startups can apply in one of two categories: Impact Tech and Dual Use Tech.

The two categories: 

  • Impact Tech: Innovative technologies and solutions creating measurable environmental or social impact while building scalable businesses.
  • Dual Use Tech: Innovations and technologies with dual-use potential, enabling applications in both civilian markets and the security and defence sector.

Why apply?

  • Pitch live on stage at Startup Nights (5-6 November 2026) in front of investors, experts, media, and the Swiss startup ecosystem.🚀
  • Win exclusive prizes.🏆
  • Receive valuable feedback from an experienced jury.💬
  • Increase your visibility, confidence, and network.🤝
  • Participation is completely free.🙌

Application Criteria

  • Founding year 2018 or later
  • Minimum viable product (MVP) available
  • Headquarter in Switzerland
  • Initial funding already secured
Applications are open until 9 October 2026
